claim: BioStudies is an external EMBL-EBI database that holds descriptions of biological studies, links to data in EMBL-EBI and external databases, and orphan/supplementary data that do not fit structured archives.
future_grounding_route: Specific BioStudies records can be queued for acquisition and processed only after files, metadata, and licenses are inspected and hashed.
project_use: Supplement and study-package discovery for MS datasets.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Study-level containers and supplementary/orphan biological data linked to publications and community repositories.
why_unverifiable: BioStudies' study descriptions and files are externally submitted/hosted and must be acquired before any project grounding.
